messages:
deploy-bot: rolled out v2026.04.12-canary->prod (100%). kicking off postdeploy smoke: prefill-warmup, proxy-smoke, embed-synth :rocket:
sam: latam1 prefill p95 jumped 90ms -> 730ms at 2881234120, small number of OOMKilled events on one nodepool
infra-bot: k8s events (latam1):
```
Warning OOMKilled pod/prefill-224a 1m kubelet
Warning OOMKilled pod/prefill-5f9b 30s kubelet
```
tess: looks like we hit a thundering-warmup: synths targeted latam and prefills warmed simultaneously. not global, just pool latam-inference-3
sre-oncall: can we phase the warmup instead of rollback? prefer soft fixes first
sam: propose: 1) apply synth jitter for latam targets (stagger start by 60-180s) 2) temporarily pin latam-inference-3 to previous image v2026.04.05 and set batch_size=10 override until next maintenance window
tess: +1. pin avoids customer impact while we investigate kv-cache growth pattern
sre-oncall: applying synth controller patch to add jitter to latam now
infra-bot: synth controller patch applied: jitter=60-180s, ramp=120s for latam targets
infra-bot: imageOverride applied to nodepool latam-inference-3 -> v2026.04.05, batch_size=10 via configmap patch, pods restarted gracefully :white_check_mark:
sam: prefill p95 back to ~110ms within 2m, no new OOMs reported
tess: creating incident-lite INF-2026-123 to track root cause and follow-ups (pin expiry 8h)
sre-oncall: agreed. actions: runtime to mem-profile warmup, releases to add phased-warmup to runbook, synth team to add jitter default for cross-zone runs
sam: release note blurb: "Transient prefill warmup pressure in LATAM during postdeploy synthetic warmups. Mitigated by adding jitter to synths and soft-pinning latam nodepool with a batch_size override. No customer-facing errors."
infra-bot: postdeploy summary: latam prefill warmup degraded -> mitigated by phased warmup + soft-pin; no rollback; INF-2026-123 filed
tess: marking thread for morning triage and runbook update ticket REL-2026-321
